description: This source file defines the DeviceStatusService class, which implements device status monitoring functionalities such as battery, thermal, storage, network, and device info retrieval for an iOS application.

classes.name: DeviceStatusService
classes.description: A final class conforming to DeviceStatusServicing, responsible for providing device status information including battery, thermal, storage, network, and device details.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronous method that gathers various device status metrics and returns them as an OpenClawDeviceStatusPayload object.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns payload containing device information such as device name, model, OS version, app version and build, and locale.

methods.name: batteryStatus
methods.description: Private method that retrieves current battery level and state, along with low power mode status.

methods.name: thermalStatus
methods.description: Private method that retrieves the thermal state of the device.

methods.name: storageStatus
methods.description: Private method that retrieves total, free, and used storage space on the device.

methods.name: fallbackAppBuild
methods.description: Private static method providing a fallback value for app build string if it is empty.
